top_signals.title: Stock and Bond Futures Advance as Oil Declines: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stock and bond futures advanced as crude oil extended its decline, with traders looking past the latest attacks on Saudi Arabia that threatened to widen the war in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
